raw_text: Organize texts by incorporating specific formats, structures, patterns, and features to influence the audience, facilitate accessibility, and support the text’s purpose. (I/C)
competency_statement: Organize texts using specific formats, structures, patterns, and features to influence the audience, make the text easier to understand, and support the text's purpose.
observable_behaviors: Use a clear text structure appropriate to the purpose and audience.
Include recognizable text features and patterns to guide the reader.
Arrange ideas and information in a way that helps the audience understand and engage with the text.
skill_clauses: Organize texts by incorporating specific formats.
Organize texts by incorporating specific structures.
Organize texts by incorporating specific patterns.
Organize texts by incorporating specific features.
Use these elements to influence the audience.

Use these elements to support the text's purpose.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify specific text formats, structures, patterns, and features in written texts.
student_actions.written_production: Organize and write texts using specific formats, structures, patterns, and features to support purpose and audience.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sequence ideas and information using appropriate text structures and patterns.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of text formats and features to organize writing effectively for the audience and purpose.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model organizing texts with specific structures and features to influence the audience and support purpose.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how chosen text formats, structures, patterns, and features help influence the audience and support the text's purpose.
